site_name: Land north of former Chapelcross nuclear power station

site_area_m2.preferred_rationale: Developer website states 55 hectares; NDA/SOSE releases describe 135 acres (54.6 ha) of unlicensed land; press reports 57 ha. Figures are close but not identical; developer figure preferred pending a red-line plan.
site_area_m2.notes: No red-line boundary published; coordinates are an approximate centroid of the Chapelcross estate north of the former station.

gross_floor_area_m2.notes: Stated as 'up to 161,920 sqm of data centre' floorspace, plus energy infrastructure, training facilities and industrial space.

current_land_use: Unlicensed NDA landholding adjacent to the licensed (decommissioning) Chapelcross nuclear site
previous_land_use: Part of the Chapelcross nuclear power station estate (station operated 1959-2004; cooling towers demolished 2007)
land_notes: Land owned by the Nuclear Decommissioning Authority; CX Power appointed as strategic developer of 135 acres within the unlicensed landholding under Heads of Terms (November 2025). Tenure structure (lease/sale) not disclosed. Greenfield/brownfield character of the specific 55 ha parcel not confirmed from planning documents; classed 'mixed' pending the scoping report.
